tldr: Mercury through the 4th house clarifies home, family, privacy, and emotional foundations.
body:
When Mercury moves through your 4th house, it puts language around home, family, privacy, memory, living space, roots, and what is happening behind closed doors. You may notice what is happening privately, what your home needs, or what old family and memory patterns are bringing into the present.

Something may need to be said, decided, written, questioned, or understood. It can help you name the question, make the call, or sort through the moving pieces.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for tending to the base of your life instead of only managing what other people can see.

The caution: Watch for overthinking the situation until the simple next step disappears. The risk is retreating so far inward that nothing gets named or handled.

Mercury moves through this house for a few weeks. Use the mental activity for clarity. Say the thing plainly, then let the answer tell you what comes next.
